correctness.rationale: For symmetric f the Gram projection yields p=A+B(z+w), Δ>0 and t=||Mf||²/(2〈f,Mf〉). With distinct a,b∈unit circle, a+b=2ζ, symmetrized two-kernel block h_m has Hardy moments G1=2m(m+1)overline{a+b}+O(1) and G2=2(m+1)²|a+b|²+O(m): crossed sums bounded via a≠b. Thus Hardy target ratio→ζ for ζ≠0. Shift f=1+λ(zw)^N h_m, λ=1/[4(m+1)²], obeys |f−1|≤1/2 on closed bidisk. Fixed-m coefficient weights /N^{2α} tend to Hardy weights while constant ||M||²/N^{2α}→0 precisely α>0. Sequential m,N choices place t in the disk within ε, and ζ=0 follows from nearby nonzero targets. Independently recomputed nonreal Hardy moments, not used as infinite proof.
residual_risks: This is sequential-limit existence with unbounded degree; no effective uniform degree cutoff or Hardy α=0 result.
